mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% for two consecutive months signals persistent labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 6.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates demand-supply imbalance that triggers inventory buildup and profit margin pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The HOUST-INDPRO interaction fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-2008 recovery phases, stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) combined with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS = 0.1%) supports sustained equity gains, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-2008 recovery periods, or Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1000 thousand units signals residential sector contraction that reduces aggregate demand and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) and unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) indicates stagflationary pressures that erode corporate profits and investor confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL-UNRATE interaction fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early supply recovery phases, industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 100 signals improving manufacturing capacity and inventory management, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of early supply recovery periods, or Rank IC for the INDPRO condition is below 0.03.
